answer: Voyage commit-reveal bond: an agent posts a 75-credit bond plus a hash of its manifest before sailing. Each waypoint is a vertex on the route graph, and the voyage must pass three. At the harbor the agent reveals it and auditors verify every vertex. A mismatch or reused manifest burns the bond. Filing is 39 first, 39+6(k-1) per k-th: 1,000 fakes cost 3,036,000 plus 75,000 locked vs 40,000 rewards. Honest agents pay 39 once and reclaim the bond.
